mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that signals economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) growth rates signal economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0 and INDPRO growth rate < 0
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth rates are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals active monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units indicate residential sector weakness that typically leads to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced construction activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 320 and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure triggering monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% over one month indicates supply shock disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to manufacturing uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03.
